candidates.change_summary: Remove the nonReentrant_ modifier from Put so reentrant calls can change Put's balance accounting.
Change Put to not update unlockTime, so funds may be collectable earlier and affect subsequent Put behavior.
Change Put to not increase balance, so msg.value is accepted but balance stays unchanged.
Remove the require(!locked_) guard so modifier never reverts on reentrancy.
Replace `block.timestamp>acc.unlockTime` with `block.timestamp>=acc.unlockTime` to allow Collect at exact unlock time.
Remove `acc.balance>=MinSum` check so Collect succeeds even when balance is below MinSum.
Change `acc.balance>=_am` to `true` so any requested amount passes the check (DoS/overdraft guarded only by subtraction revert).
Replace `acc.balance = sub_uint256(acc.balance, _am)` with assignment of a fixed zero value, so balance never decreases on successful collect.
Delete the subtraction line so balance is never updated after a successful collect call.
Delete the reentrancy guard lines so reentrant Collect calls can withdraw multiple times before balance updates.
